# ⌃Return reaches the pane's program (Claude Code's "send now"): AppKit
# offers a ⌃ key as a key equivalent first, and one nothing takes there
# macOS may claim — ⌃Return opens the contextual menu — so the pane takes
# it there. With the kitty keyboard protocol on (as Claude Code turns it
# on) it's CSI 13;5u, then a plain Return.
type:python3 -I @ROOT@/tests/fixtures/keys-read.py 1
key:enter
wait:1.0
key-equivalent:ctrl+enter
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect:GOT 1b 5b 31 33 3b 35 75 0d
